description: This header file contains utility functions for file operations, property reading, content loading, file type checking, recursive file searching, and variable expansion within strings. It is part of the 'Utils' namespace and provides helper functions for managing and processing files and properties in a larger project.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, supporting recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching a pattern in a directory structure, with exclusion lists and depth control.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive search for files starting from a given path, with depth limits and exclusions.

methods.description: Expands variable references within a string based on property values read from a file.
